title: MV Released a free demo of my indie game today ;-)

posts.author: rhinosoup
posts.body:
Hypocrite [Demo]
​
Engine:
RPG Maker MV
Genre:
Surreal Horror / Psychological RPG
Rating:
PG-13 (contains sensitive content, see below)
Language:
English
Content Warning:
This game includes mentions of
gore
,
religious trauma
, and
mental illness
. Play at your own risk. This is not an R18+ game, but themes are heavy.
I’m like, super super new to RPG Maker and all the coding stuff. But hey, I’m proud I made my first game! This is a really, really demo demo. It’s short, janky, and definitely not finished, but full of heart.
Hypocrite is a surreal RPG heavily focused on art (my art
) and
my OCs
. You play as
Rhain
, with themes of doppelgängers. As for gameplay: press space or enter to interact with objects, use WASD or arrow keys to move, and shift to sprint. For password codes, use up/down/left/right. The menu is still undone (I don’t know how to customize it, help), but it’ll be better in the final game, trust.
The game is loosely set in a warped version of the early 1900s, but deliberately breaks historical accuracy for surrealism and emotional effect. You’ll see tech that shouldn’t exist, ideas that feel modern, and entities that don’t belong anywhere. It’s more vibes than logic.
Gameplay is mainly focused on
exploration
and
dialogue choices
, with some
light puzzles
and
analogue horror-inspired visuals
. Art and mood are the main priorities in this demo.
This is very much a game about atmosphere, confusion, and doppelgängers. If you like titles like
8:11
,
END ROLL
, or
Deadplate
, you might find something to enjoy here.
Demo Download:
https://rhinosoup.itch.io/hypocrite
It’s free to play. All plugins are credited in-game during the ending credits.
Please note that this demo is rough and unfinished. I’m actively working on updates and will be improving things based on feedback.
Demo testers will be credited in the final game.
AI Usage Disclosure:
No AI-generated art, writing, or assets were used in this project.
Credits:
Full plugin credits are shown in the ending scene of the demo.
Thanks for checking it out!

posts.author: lavandul
posts.body:
hihi! little comments as i got through your demo. i got end 1 and got through the meat wall section but was kinda trapped after erico saved me after the first trigger. i spammed everything but nothing seemed to progress the plot. this took me roughly 20 minutes for my second run.
my main thoughts
I enjoyed how many things there were to do! i spent a lot of time clicking around and did enjoy the various scenes and maps that were included
connecting that past rhain was current adult rhain was honestly a delightful surprise for me. i wonder why he no longer has his teal ears </3
as a rough demo I see there's genuinely a lot of potential
the amount of handdrawn artwork was honestly outstanding and I can see there were a lot of love and effort put into this game
the dialogue sometimes struggles to find a cohesive tone. the visuals and sense of unease built up a lot of tension but there were a lot of sudden jokes thrown in that somewhat broke immersion for me
--
some points to revise
Transitioning between maps/clicking on doors felts super clunky- I would recommend using "player touch" instead of "action button" to trigger either a popup indicating "the door is locked" or "you can't enter here" or something along those lines!
image flashing before being shown --> i think this can be solved by using a preloader plugin!
grammatical errors + some typos you might want to reread the script for (here's an example for the starting lines of the game)
selfishness should be used i think? // there were other moments too
text got cutoff (alot of dialgoue after encountering rusty)
overall! i wish you lots of luck with your game development.

posts.author: Etrikia
posts.body: I gave it a play! I understand it's a rough demo so I won't judge it too harshly.  Think there's huge potential for a good story and the color theory is immaculate even in the sketches. I was confused with what i was able to see, especially with the  pre-loaded, unfinshable save file too.  I'm not is there are other routes loaded into this demo but the ending was really scary!! My only big suggestion is find another footstep sound on freesounds or the like PRONTO.
